title: Verify project prerequisites and access
description: Verify that Python virtual environment, OpenCV, TensorFlow/Keras dependencies, Node.js tooling, environment variables in .env.local, and camera device permissions are accessible before implementation begins.
acceptanceCriteria: .env.local exists with placeholder entries for required environment variables without committing secrets
Python environment has required libraries installed (opencv-python, tensorflow/keras, numpy)
Node.js package dependencies in lib/ are verified and build scripts work
Camera access check can be executed safely or reports simulated fallback without crashing

steps.description: Read prerequisite requirements from the PRD
steps.details: Open .agent/prd/PRD.md and verify Python dependencies in requirements.txt and Node dependencies in lib/package.json.
Confirm .env.local exists with APP_ENV, HOST, PORT, DEFAULT_CAMERA_INDEX, and LOG_LEVEL.
Run a test script importing cv2, numpy, and check if tensorflow or onnxruntime are present.
Confirm npm dependencies in lib/ are installed and playwright config is valid.

technicalNotes: Ensure secrets stay local and are never logged or committed.
If physical webcam is not attached, provide a fallback synthetic frame generator for testing.
